# Third-party data in this folder

`schreurs2024_supplementary.xlsx` is a byte-identical copy (renamed only) of the file
`Supplemental Files and Figure source files.xlsx` (5,261,473 bytes) in the Zenodo record

> Schreurs, M., Piampongsant, S., Roncoroni, M., Cool, L., Herrera-Malaver, B., Vanderaa, C., et al.
> *Data from: Predicting and improving complex beer flavor through machine learning.* Zenodo (2024).
> https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10653704 — accompanying Schreurs et al., *Nature Communications* 15, 2368 (2024).

It is redistributed under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence
(https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). No changes were made to the file; all derived tables in
`results/extension/` are computed from it by the scripts in `extension/`.
